prose: Advanced astrology teacher Meg Moonbeam joins Chance Garton for a lesson on personal astrology that goes well past sun signs. How does a natal chart show who you're meant to be? Tune in for practical answers.
Recorded during a Mercury retrograde that nearly ruined the interview file, and saved by a backup recording!
topics: Pre-natal and post-natal eclipses that reveal where your soul just came from and where it is headed, and what it means to be an "eclipse baby."
Why Chiron, the wounded healer, hides your deepest trigger AND your greatest strength, and the simple mental shift that changes how the world responds to you.
How to use your North Node as a decision-making compass.
